title: Who will be the next James Bond? – level 1
paragraphs: Actors Jack Lowden, Josh O’Connor, and Callum Turner are trying to become the new James Bond. Big tests are happening now to see who is best at fighting, talking, and acting on camera.
Jack Lowden is the favorite right now, but other actors also have a chance. Leaders want to pick a strong actor from Britain or a connected country.
Fans around the world are excited to learn who will play the famous spy. The final news about the new James Bond will come around Christmas time.

words.d: the person who many people think will win
very happy and keen on something
a person who gets secret information
